paragraphs: Rav Huna bar Katina: Nedarim 65b; chapter Arvei Pesachim, in Rav Huna’s time (I did not find it). Rav Huna, son of Rav Katina, sat before Rav Chisda: Zevachim 115b. He reported Rabbi Yitzchak: Gittin 43b; in this matter at 38, end of side a: Rav Chanina bar Katina. He reported Resh Lakish: Chullin 17, end of side b. Rav Chana and Rabbi Daniel may be his brothers.
